book.infestusfrontier.waking_genome.name: The Waking Genome
book.infestusfrontier.waking_genome.desc: A field journal for controlled living construction.
book.infestusfrontier.waking_genome.cont: Start a controlled living patch and learn its first preparations.
book.infestusfrontier.entry.waking_genom: Pages explain what to do. They grant no materials or machine access. The server records successful actions. Losing this book loses no research. Press the guide key to return here.
Lost books can be recrafted with the recipe above. Recrafting never resets progress.
book.infestusfrontier.entry.spore_cultur: Craft and renew the starter Culture.
Gather the ingredients shown above for your first Culture. The next page shows how a rooted Bowl renews it.
book.infestusfrontier.entry.synaptic_pro: Inspect and control a reachable Bowl.

Craft the reusable Probe from one bone, one slime ball and one Spore Culture. Use it on a reachable Bowl to inspect slots, water, progress and refusal details. Select a recipe, then start or safely cancel it. Empty hands and offhand building remain available.
book.infestusfrontier.entry.living_subst: Apply one Spore Culture to the visible face of eligible dirt or host stone. Only that selected loaded cell changes; no autonomous spread or chunk loading occurs. Bone meal grows your cell from basic to young, then mature.
book.infestusfrontier.entry.organ_bud.de: A placeable precursor for living organs.
book.infestusfrontier.entry.organ_bud.pa: Craft a Bud using the recipe above, or grow it in a rooted Bowl using the next page. Plant it for registered organ construction.
book.infestusfrontier.entry.culture_bowl: Run one reserved starter preparation at a time.
Craft the Bowl using the recipe above. Place it only on Living Substrate.

Load ingredients by hand and water by bucket. Stick: cycle recipes. Empty hand: start. Sneak + stick: cancel. Sneak + empty hand: collect. The Probe offers these controls too. Starting reserves supplies and output space; a full Bowl refuses safely. Cancel releases reserved supplies. Work requires a loaded Bowl on Living Substrate.
Reserve output space before starting. The next page shows its Bowl recipe.
book.infestusfrontier.entry.nutrient_mas: Feed for later cultures, not player food.
Nutrient Mash is a preparation, not edible player food. The next page shows its Bowl recipe.
book.infestusfrontier.entry.honey_cultur: A honey-adapted preparation with its bottle returned.
Output and returned bottle space must both be available. The next page shows its Bowl recipe.
Preparation for selected crop and woody beds.
Planting still needs real seed, sapling or cutting stock. The next page shows its Bowl recipe.
